speaker: john_heminges
text: Both heels. Every man. New hose for the whole company, out of the stock, and I will see them on you before I see them in a basket.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Both of mine, John. They are whole.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Twenty-six shillings. Out of the stock, not out of a triumph. Turn.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Find a hole in that, grocer. Thou'lt find none; I've walked on my hands since November.

speaker: john_heminges
text: I am looking at the sole, Will, not at the story. The sole is new.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Thou hast made thy point with the feet. Let him keep the shillings.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Then look at mine, which are not the new. A fist would go through that heel.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Greenwich. That was the heel. I have wondered a year whose it was, and it was mine, and I am satisfied.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Satisfied is not dressed, Thomas. The new pair is on the bench. Put it on, and then forgive yourself.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: I will put it on. I am satisfied first. A man may have both.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Three books. Sixty rolls. The chest shuts, and I am sitting on it. The man who wants a roll may ask me.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Sit, then. Nobody opens it on the road but you. If the paper is wet on Wednesday I will know whose seat failed.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Hear the order of going, once. Sharers. Then the hired men. Then the boys.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Nobody speaks to a yeoman of the guard before I have spoken. Nobody touches a hanging. A hanging is the room's.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: And if a yeoman speaks first?

speaker: george_bryan
text: You answer that George Bryan will come. You do not begin a conversation with a wall.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: Is the Queen truly there, or is it the chair again?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The court went up to Richmond this morning. She is there. The chair is a chair until she sits in it, and thou wilt bow to it empty if thou must.

speaker: sam_latchet
text: I can bow to a chair. I did, when you taught it. I want to know which bow Friday is.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Friday's bow is the one I give you in the room. This morning's news is only that the town has her. Do not spend it.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Nick has not sung a note for four days. Augustine's order. Augustine is not in this room to say it a second time.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave him. He is carrying it full. Four days is the order, and the order is holding.

speaker: will_kemp
text: A full cup, and not a song. Thou'lt do, lad, and thou wilt not do it today.

speaker: john_heminges
text: No play after this. The hose are the work. Baskets by the door when you go down. God keep you.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: And you. I am for home. I am not counting a coffer on the way.
